colors._note: Rep 4 (Maven Toys): friendly retail. Deep teal leads (header band, KPI values, current period), coral is the accent (Low stock, out of stock, bottom stores), mustard is the third colour (last year, Overstock). good/bad colour only the vs-PY pills. Every *Dark colour is the text colour for its tint. accent (3.2:1) and mustard (2.2:1) are for marks only, never text; all text pairs are 4.5:1 or better.

status._note: Stock Status colours (table cell background + text, and the status chart series), as names from colors.

chart._note: Series order for the theme's dataColors, as names from colors. Current period = teal, last year = mustard.

fontPt._note: Power BI sizes in points: font px x 0.75, halves round up; caption raised from 9 to 10 for legibility (Rep 1 lesson).

pbiShadow._note: Rep 3 review: Power BI draws the CSS shadow darker, so visuals use this lighter mapping (colour from shadow).

control._note: Slicers and buttons (px). Button slicers under ~40px need padding.default Custom 0 top/bottom (CLAUDE.md).
